value.rationale: The refined terminal-removable distribution is the exact distribution of the count of feasible last participants/deletions in a minimum-arc network that guarantees universal consensus, not a gratuitous degree slicing. Distinguishes edge sets from multi-counted attachment orders; includes all-order analytic recurrence and maximal reversibility extreme 2^(n-2). Supports uniform sampling and structural robustness analysis even though the unrefined sequence is known; does not claim behavioral time bounds or paper-sized contribution.
